bio: An attractive, contemporary-style restaurant with an impressive setting on Plaza de España plus a delightful terrace. It is run by a charming couple (Carlos and Kim), with the former in the kitchen and the latter front of house. Choose between a Mediterranean-influenced à la carte that includes seasonal dishes, and an impressive tasting menu. We particularly enjoyed and can recommend one of its starters, the dish entitled Prawns / Kataifi / Foie Gras Sauce....
